title: When Semi-Supervised LVM Meets Frequency-Based Critical Layout Pattern Selection
problem: Identifying critical lithography patterns for process optimization requires manual annotation, which is time-consuming and subjective.
motivation: Automated pattern criticality detection reduces manual effort and improves consistency in lithography pattern selection.
method: Semi-supervised learning with Vision Transformers (ViT) for pattern classification. Frequency domain analysis for criticality assessment. Combines image and frequency-based features.
key_novelty: First semi-supervised approach combining ViT and frequency analysis for lithography pattern criticality detection.
limitations: Quantitative metrics not provided; generalization to new technology nodes not discussed.
